Multi diuitias despiciunt, quos parvo contentos tenuis victus,cultusq; delectat:honores vero, quorum cupiditate quidam inflamantur,quam multi ita contēnunt ut nihil inanius esse, nihil levius existiment. Item cætera quæ quibusdā admirabilia videntur,permulti sunt,qui pro nihilo putent. De amicitia omnes ad unum idem sentiunt & hi qui ad rempu. se cō-tulerūt,& ii qui rerum cognitione doctrinaq; delectantur, & ii qui suum negotium gerunt otiose,postremò ii,qui se totos voluptatibus tradiderunt,sine amicitia vitam esse nullam sentiunt, si modò velint aliqua ex parte liberaliter vivere.Serpit enim nescio quomodo ꝑ omnium vita amicitia , nec ullam ætatis degendæ ratione patitur esse sui expertem. page.notes: The text is set in a single roman column. "rempu." and "sotietatem" are doubtful readings: the scan is faint there, and "sotietatem" may be a printing error for "societatem". "Titomem" is printed as such and is left unchanged. The "ꝑ" before "omnium" is a per-abbreviation with a stroke over the p. The final word "ra-" is broken at the line end and continues on the next page; the catchword is "men".
